name: Manage Tasks (CRUD)
summary: Create, update, delete, and list tasks. Covers assignment and status changes.

steps.note: Always list first to get exact task_id. Never guess IDs.
update_task(task_id, field, new_value) for status/priority/title changes. delete_task(task_id) for removal. Field 'status' values: open|in_progress|completed|cancelled

notes: task_id format: task_0001, task_0002 etc — get from list_tasks
